items.title: Call to Order
notes:
Mayor Guthrie called the meeting to order (6:00 p.m.).

Mayor Guthrie provided opening remarks, and noted the following:

Public Meeting to Hear Complaint Under Section 20 of the Development Charges Act, 1997

As per Section 4 (1) of the Statutory Powers and Procedures Act, City Council sitting as a Tribunal consents to waive the 14-day notice provision under Section 20 (5) of the Development Charges Act, and acknowledged that both the complainant and respondent consented to this waiver in writing.

notes: Joe Hoffman, counsel on behalf of 601 Scottsdale GP Inc., provided a response to the presentation made by Peter Gross, counsel for the Respondent.

items.title: Authority to move into closed
notes:
Mayor Guthrie noted the following: 

Councillor Caron had declared a pecuniary interest for the Development Charges Complaint - 601 Scottsdale Drive as this property is owned by her employer and that she left the meeting prior to the hearing beginning.

Councillor Goller and Councillor Klassen had provided regrets for the meeting.

items.title: Open Meeting
notes: Mayor Guthrie called the meeting to order (8:44 p.m.).

motions.text: Council shall now deliberate in closed session: As per Section 9(1) (b) of the Statutory Powers Procedure Act, intimate financial or personal matters or other matters may be disclosed at the hearing of such a nature, having regard to the circumstances, that the desirability of avoiding disclosure thereof in the interests of any person affected or in the public interest outweighs the desirability of adhering to the principle that hearings be open to the public.
motions.text_html:
Council shall now deliberate in closed session:

As per Section 9(1) (b) of the Statutory Powers Procedure Act, intimate financial or personal matters or other matters may be disclosed at the hearing of such a nature, having regard to the circumstances, that the desirability of avoiding disclosure thereof in the interests of any person affected or in the public interest outweighs the desirability of adhering to the principle that hearings be open to the public.

motions.text: That the meeting be adjourned (8:46 p.m.).
